name: devletes/filament-notifications-max
description: Real-time, preference-driven notifications for Filament: database + broadcast + email channels, per-user preferences, an admin broadcaster, a full notification center, and rate limiting. Reverb-ready.

suggest.laravel-notification-channels/twilio: Required to deliver SMS via Twilio (enable channel_handlers.twilio).
suggest.laravel/vonage-notification-channel: Required to deliver SMS via Vonage (enable channel_handlers.vonage).
suggest.laravel/slack-notification-channel: Required to deliver Slack messages (enable channel_handlers.slack).
suggest.laravel-notification-channels/discord: Required to deliver Discord messages (enable channel_handlers.discord).
suggest.nikic/php-parser: Required by `notifications-max:generate-types` to scan host code for dispatcher call sites and auto-fill the type registry.
